title: Xona’s commercial GPS alternative is about to go live
summary: Xona's precision timing and navigation service will enter beta testing after SpaceX launches six satellites designed by the company. This commercial alternative to GPS could provide more accurate positioning for various applications.
content: Xona's precision timing and navigation service will enter beta testing after SpaceX launches six satellites designed by the company.

zh.title: Xona的商业GPS替代方案即将上线
zh.summary: 在SpaceX发射该公司设计的六颗卫星后，Xona的精准定时和导航服务将进入测试阶段。这个GPS商业替代方案可以为各种应用提供更精确的定位。

title: Rocket Report: A rare Falcon 9 scrub; is it just about Vulcan's time to shine?
summary: SpaceX experienced a rare Falcon 9 launch delay as competitors like Vulcan prepare to enter the commercial spaceflight market. The timing suggests a shift in the competitive landscape for rocket launches.
content: "I can say we’re weeks away from launching on Vulcan."

zh.title: 火箭报告：罕见的猎鹰9号中止；现在是火神的闪耀时刻吗？
zh.summary: 在竞争对手如火神准备进入商业太空飞行市场时，SpaceX经历了罕见的猎鹰9号发射延迟。这个时机表明火箭发射的竞争格局正在发生转变。

title: Volkswagen's replacement for the ID.4 crossover is here
summary: Volkswagen has launched a new electric vehicle to replace the ID.4 crossover, featuring a digital cockpit with retro-inspired instrument displays. The new model represents VW's continued evolution in the EV market.
content: The new EV’s digital cockpit can mimic instrument displays from VWs of old.

zh.title: 大众汽车的ID.4跨界车替代品已上市
zh.summary: 大众汽车推出了一款新型电动汽车来替代ID.4跨界车，具有带有复古灵感仪表盘的数字座舱。这款新车型代表了大众汽车在电动汽车市场的持续发展。

title: OpenAI doubles down on decision to fire three AI safety researchers
summary: OpenAI has reaffirmed its decision to terminate three safety researchers—Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak, and Mikita Balesni—citing violations of information handling policies. The company denied the dismissals were retaliation for the researchers' public concerns about AI safety.
content:
OpenAI is standing firm on its decision to fire three safety researchers after an investigation found they committed "a significant breach of trust."
In a post on X on Friday, the company said Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak and Mikita ⁠Balesni were dismissed for violating "clear policies on handling sensitive information." It insisted the decision was not about the trio speaking out about the company and their concerns about AI safety.

zh.title: OpenAI坚持解雇三名AI安全研究员的决定
zh.summary: OpenAI已确认终止三名安全研究员（Jasmine Wang、Tomek Korbak和Mikita Balesni）的决定，理由是违反了信息处理政策。该公司否认解雇是对这些研究员公开表达AI安全担忧的报复。

title: Microsoft 365 Family subscribers will finally be able to share AI benefits
summary: Microsoft is expanding access to AI-powered Copilot features to secondary accounts on Microsoft 365 Family and Premium plans, allowing up to five additional users to share these benefits. This change makes AI tools more accessible to household members beyond the primary account holder.
content:
Microsoft bundled its AI-powered Office features into Microsoft 365 Personal and Family subscriptions last year, but it only allowed the primary account holder to access the AI benefits. Now, Microsoft is about to let Microsoft 365 Family and Premium subscribers share Copilot and AI usage features, alongside access to Office apps and OneDrive storage, with up to five other people on a plan.
In an email to Microsoft 365 Family and Premium subscribers seen by The Verge, Microsoft outlines the changes that are coming to subscription plans over the coming months:

zh.title: Microsoft 365 Family用户终于可以共享AI优势
zh.summary: 微软正在扩展对AI支持的Copilot功能的访问权限，使Microsoft 365 Family和Premium计划中的副账户也能使用，允许多达五个额外用户共享这些优势。这一变化使AI工具对主账户持有人之外的家庭成员更加易于访问。
